content.name: All Ships with Filters
content.author: Chem O`Dun
content.description:
Adds an [b]All Ships with Filters[/b] tab to the [b]Property Owned[/b] menu in the map. The tab shows all owned ships in three sections: [b]Fleets[/b], [b]Stations with Assigned Ships[/b] (subordinate ships only, without module or construction rows), and [b]Unassigned Ships[/b]. Supports multi-dimensional filtering by ship type, size, sector, dock status, default behaviour, current order, and failed orders.
[h2][b]Features[/b][/h2] [list] [*] [b]All Ships tab[/b]: A dedicated tab in the Property Owned menu lists every owned ship in three sections - Fleets, Stations with Assigned Ships, and Unassigned Ships - using the same ship rows as the vanilla view (hull bars, action buttons, sub-expansion). [*] [b]Stations section[/b]: Shows only the subordinate ships assigned to each station, hiding module and construction rows for a cleaner list. [*] [b]Multi-dimensional filtering[/b]: Add up to one filter per available dimension. Each filter row has a category dropdown and, once a category is selected, a value dropdown. Multiple filter slots appear automatically; remove a slot by setting its category back to None. [*] [b]Filter dimensions[/b]: [b]Type[/b] (ship purpose), [b]Size[/b] (hull class), [b]Sector[/b], [b]Docked[/b] (yes/no), [b]Default Behaviour[/b], [b]Current Order[/b], [b]Failed Orders[/b]. [*] [b]Fleet handling[/b]: A fleet is shown whenever the fleet commander or at least one subordinate passes the active filters. Fleet unit group entries are always preserved so the expand/collapse button remains functional. [*] [b]Expand/collapse all[/b]: When the list contains expandable entries (fleets or stations with subordinates), a master +/- button appears in the filter header row to expand or collapse all at once. [*] [b]Compatible with X4 8.00 and 9.00[/b]. [/list] [h2][b]Requirements[/b][/h2] [list] [*] [b]X4: Foundations[/b]: Version [b]8.00HF4[/b] or higher and [b]UI Extensions and HUD[/b]: Version [b]v8.0.4.x[/b] or higher by [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/kuertee?gameId=2659]kuertee[/url]: [list] [*] Available on Nexus Mods: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/x4foundations/mods/552]UI Extensions and HUD[/url] [/list] [*] [b]X4: Foundations[/b]: Version [b]9.00 beta 3[/b] or higher and [b]UI Extensions and HUD[/b]: Version [b]v9.0.0.0.3[/b] or higher by [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/kuertee?gameId=2659]kuertee[/url]. [*] [b]Mod Support APIs[/b]: Version 1.95 or higher by [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/sirnukes?gameId=2659]SirNukes[/url]: [list] [*] Available on Steam: [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2042901274]SirNukes Mod Support APIs[/url] [*] Available on Nexus Mods: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/x4foundations/mods/503]Mod Support APIs[/url] [/list] [*] [b]Options Helper[/b]: Version 1.0 or higher by [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/ChemODun/mods?gameId=2659]Chem O`Dun[/url]: [list] [*] Available on Steam: [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3715253556]Options Helper[/url] [*] Available on Nexus Mods: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/x4foundations/mods/2089]Options Helper[/url] [/list] [/list] [h2][b]Installation[/b][/h2] [list] [*] [b]Steam Workshop[/b]: [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3715969856]All Ships with Filters[/url] [*] [b]Nexus Mods[/b]: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/x4foundations/mods/2094]All Ships with Filters[/url] [/list] [h2][b]Usage[/b][/h2]
Open the map, switch to the [b]Property Owned[/b] panel, and click the [b]All Ships with Filters[/b] tab in the tab strip. [img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/chemodun/X4-AllShipsWithFilters/refs/heads/main/docs/images/all_ships.png[/img]
[h2]Filter rows[/h2]
The top of the tab contains one or more [b]filter rows[/b]. Each row has: [list] [*] A [b]category dropdown[/b] - choose the dimension to filter by (Type, Size, Sector, Docked, Default Behaviour, Current Order, Failed Orders). Setting this back to None removes only that slot; the remaining slots are preserved. Changing it to a different category removes all slots after it, since their value selections may no longer be meaningful. [*] A [b]value dropdown[/b] - appears once a category is chosen; select the specific value to match. Choosing None here shows all ships regardless of that dimension's value. [/list] Additional filter slots appear automatically when all existing slots have an active category. All active filters are applied simultaneously (AND logic).
[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/chemodun/X4-AllShipsWithFilters/refs/heads/main/docs/images/failed_orders.png[/img]
[h2]Expand/collapse all[/h2]
When the ship list contains expandable entries (fleet leaders or stations with subordinates), a [b]+/-[/b] button appears in the filter header row. Clicking it expands or collapses every expandable entry at once.
[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/chemodun/X4-AllShipsWithFilters/refs/heads/main/docs/images/failed_orders_size_m_all_expanded.png[/img]
[h2]Sections[/h2] [list] [*] [b]Fleets[/b]: Fleet leaders and their subordinates. A fleet is visible if the commander or any subordinate passes the active filter. When a fleet is shown but only some subordinates match, the subordinate list is pre-filtered so only matching ships appear inside the expanded fleet. The fleet leader row itself is always shown even if the commander does not match, as long as at least one subordinate does. [*] [b]Stations with Assigned Ships[/b]: Only stations that have at least one assigned ship passing the filter are shown. The subordinate ship list inside each station is pre-filtered to matching ships only; module and construction rows are never shown. [*] [b]Unassigned Ships[/b]: Ships not assigned to a fleet or station that pass the active filter. [/list] [img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/chemodun/X4-AllShipsWithFilters/refs/heads/main/docs/images/size_s_fight_escort_heretics_end.png[/img] [img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/chemodun/X4-AllShipsWithFilters/refs/heads/main/docs/images/size_m_fight_escort_heretics_end.png[/img] [img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/chemodun/X4-AllShipsWithFilters/refs/heads/main/docs/images/docked.png[/img]
[h2]Extension options[/h2]
[b]Options Menu > Extension options > All Ships with Filters[/b]: [list] [*] [b]Debug mode[/b]: Controls log verbosity. Options: None (default), Debug, Trace. Use Debug or Trace only when troubleshooting - these write to the game log on every refresh. [/list] [img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/chemodun/X4-AllShipsWithFilters/refs/heads/main/docs/images/extension_options.png[/img]
[h2][b]Credits[/b][/h2] [list] [*] [b]Author[/b]: Chem O`Dun, on [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/ChemODun/mods?gameId=2659]Nexus Mods[/url] and [url=https://steamcommunity.com/id/chemodun/myworkshopfiles/?appid=392160]Steam Workshop[/url] [*] [i]"X4: Foundations"[/i] is a trademark of [url=https://www.egosoft.com]Egosoft[/url]. [/list] [h2][b]Acknowledgements[/b][/h2] [list] [*] [url=https://www.egosoft.com]EGOSOFT[/url] - for the X series. [*] [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/kuertee?gameId=2659]kuertee[/url] - for the [b]UI Extensions and HUD[/b] that makes this extension possible. text.description: Adds an All Ships with Filters tab to the Property Owned menu in the map. The tab shows all owned ships in three sections: Fleets, Stations with Assigned Ships (expanded to show only the subordinate ships, without module or construction rows), and Unassigned Ships. Supports filtering by ship type, size, sector, dock status, default behaviour, current order, and failed orders.

Ajoute un onglet Tous les vaisseaux avec filtres au menu Propriété dans la carte. L'onglet affiche tous les vaisseaux possédés en trois sections : Flottes, Stations avec vaisseaux assignés (développées pour afficher uniquement les vaisseaux subordonnés, sans les rangées de modules ou de construction), et Vaisseaux non assignés. Prend en charge le filtrage par type de vaisseau, taille, secteur, statut d'amarrage, comportement par défaut, ordre actuel et ordres échoués.

Añade una pestaña Todas las naves con filtros al menú Propiedad del mapa. La pestaña muestra todas las naves en tres secciones: Flotas, Estaciones con naves asignadas (expandidas para mostrar solo las naves subordinadas, sin filas de módulos ni de construcción) y Naves sin asignar. Admite filtrado por tipo de nave, tamaño, sector, estado de atraque, comportamiento predeterminado, orden actual y órdenes fallidas.

Aggiunge una scheda Tutte le navi con filtri al menu Proprietà nella mappa. La scheda mostra tutte le navi possedute in tre sezioni: Flotte, Stazioni con navi assegnate (espanse per mostrare solo le navi subordinate, senza righe di moduli o costruzione) e Navi non assegnate. Supporta il filtraggio per tipo di nave, dimensione, settore, stato di attracco, comportamento predefinito, ordine corrente e ordini falliti.

Přidává záložku Všechny lodě s filtry do nabídky Vlastnictví na mapě. Záložka zobrazuje všechny vlastněné lodě ve třech sekcích: Flotily, Stanice s přiřazenými loděmi (rozbalené pro zobrazení pouze podřízených lodí, bez řádků modulů nebo stavby) a Nepřiřazené lodě. Podporuje filtrování podle typu lodě, velikosti, sektoru, stavu dokování, výchozího chování, aktuálního rozkazu a neúspěšných rozkazů.

Adds an All Ships with Filters tab to the Property Owned menu in the map. The tab shows all owned ships in three sections: Fleets, Stations with Assigned Ships (expanded to show only the subordinate ships, without module or construction rows), and Unassigned Ships. Supports filtering by ship type, size, sector, dock status, default behaviour, current order, and failed orders.

Dodaje kartę Wszystkie statki z filtrami do menu Własność na mapie. Karta wyświetla wszystkie posiadane statki w trzech sekcjach: Floty, Stacje z przypisanymi statkami (rozwinięte, aby pokazać tylko podległe statki, bez wierszy modułów lub budowy) oraz Nieprzypisane statki. Obsługuje filtrowanie według typu statku, rozmiaru, sektora, statusu dokowania, domyślnego zachowania, bieżącego rozkazu i nieudanych rozkazów.

Fügt einen Reiter Alle Schiffe mit Filtern zum Eigentum-Menü auf der Karte hinzu. Der Reiter zeigt alle eigenen Schiffe in drei Abschnitten: Flotten, Stationen mit zugewiesenen Schiffen (erweitert, um nur die untergeordneten Schiffe ohne Modul- oder Bauzeilen anzuzeigen) und Nicht zugewiesene Schiffe. Unterstützt das Filtern nach Schiffstyp, Größe, Sektor, Andockstatus, Standardverhalten, aktuellem Befehl und fehlgeschlagenen Befehlen.

Adiciona uma guia Todas as naves com filtros ao menu Propriedade no mapa. A guia exibe todas as naves possuídas em três seções: Frotas, Estações com naves atribuídas (expandidas para mostrar apenas as naves subordinadas, sem linhas de módulos ou construção) e Naves não atribuídas. Suporta filtragem por tipo de nave, tamanho, setor, status de atracação, comportamento padrão, ordem atual e ordens com falha.
マップの所有物メニューにフィルター付き全艦船タブを追加します。このタブは所有する全艦船を3つのセクションで表示します：艦隊、配属艦船のある宇宙基地（モジュールや建設行の代わりに従属艦船のみを表示）、未配属艦船。艦船タイプ、サイズ、セクター、ドッキング状態、デフォルト行動、現在の命令、失敗した命令でフィルタリングできます。
맵의 소유물 메뉴에 필터가 있는 모든 함선 탭을 추가합니다. 이 탭은 소유한 모든 함선을 세 섹션으로 표시합니다: 함대, 배속 함선이 있는 정거장(모듈이나 건설 행 없이 하위 함선만 표시), 미배속 함선. 함선 유형, 크기, 구역, 도킹 상태, 기본 행동, 현재 명령, 실패한 명령으로 필터링을 지원합니다.
在地图的财产菜单中添加带筛选器的所有飞船标签页。该标签页将所有拥有的飞船分三个部分显示：舰队、分配有飞船的空间站（展开后仅显示下属飞船，不显示模块或建设行）以及未分配飞船。支持按飞船类型、大小、星区、停靠状态、默认行为、当前命令和失败命令进行筛选。
在地圖的財產選單中新增帶篩選器的所有飛船標籤頁。該標籤頁將所有擁有的飛船分三個部分顯示：艦隊、分配有飛船的太空站（展開後僅顯示下屬飛船，不顯示模組或建設行）以及未分配飛船。支援按飛船類型、大小、星區、停靠狀態、預設行為、當前命令和失敗命令進行篩選。

Haritadaki Mülk menüsüne Filtreli Tüm Gemiler sekmesi ekler. Sekme, sahip olunan tüm gemileri üç bölümde gösterir: Filolar, Atanmış Gemileri Olan İstasyonlar (modül veya inşaat satırları olmadan yalnızca bağlı gemileri gösterecek şekilde genişletilmiş) ve Atanmamış Gemiler. Gemi türü, boyut, sektör, yanaşma durumu, varsayılan davranış, mevcut emir ve başarısız emirlere göre filtrelemeyi destekler.

Додає вкладку Усі кораблі з фільтрами до меню Власність на карті. Вкладка відображає всі власні кораблі у трьох розділах: Флоти, Станції з призначеними кораблями (розгорнуті для відображення лише підпорядкованих кораблів, без рядків модулів або будівництва) та Непризначені кораблі. Підтримує фільтрацію за типом корабля, розміром, сектором, статусом стикування, поведінкою за замовчуванням, поточним наказом та невиконаними наказами.
